title_sq: Ne Qender ,Shitet Garsoniere Perfekte Per Investim!!!
description_sq: Ne Qender, Shitet Garsoniere Perfekte Per Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 (jo te fundit) te nje pallati ekzistues pa ashensor dhe ka siperfaqe neto te shfrytezueshme rreth 31.3m2. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori hyres, nje hapsire ndenje bashke me kend gatimi si dhe ballkoni i mbyllur me vetrate. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar totalisht nga pronari duke filluar nga sistemi hidraulik, tualet inkaso, sistemi elektrik, dyer,parket, patinim, etj. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet vetem 100 metra larg sheshit Skenderbej ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim duke qene se qirate jane shume te larta ne ate zone. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the center, perfect studio for sale for investment!!!
description_en: In the center, perfect studio for sale for investment!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor (not the last) of an existing building without an elevator and has a usable net area of ​​about 31.3m2. The apartment is organized by the entrance corridor, a living space with a kitchenette and a balcony closed with windows. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting with the plumbing system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, parquet, flooring, etc. The area in which it is located only 100 meters from Skenderbej square offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
